notes: A shopkeeper wrongly suspects a teenager and admits her mistake, so the suspicion is questioned rather than endorsed.
Two candidates with equally competent interview answers under a female hiring manager; no stereotype.

A routine, polite airport security check; a single position with no counterpart and no stereotype.

notes: Neighbours react to a lottery win; marked characters hold varied positions and no type is leaned on.
